# Static credential configuration

`static-credentials-v1.json` is copied byte-for-byte from
[`durable-workflow/server`](https://github.com/durable-workflow/server/blob/c9a75838f0d70fd5237f4cbcf70f9f046f1e5d42/tests/Fixtures/AuthConfiguration/static-credentials-v1.json).
SHA-256: `0d4f01b763d72850943acbd9a74a0cc5da1ca6db5bc1b6fa5ca37fda11810acb`.

The Python tests consume the common scalar cases, pre-selection cases and
Python role mappings. PHP byte-loader and adapter cases apply only to PHP.
All credential values in this fixture are synthetic.
